PlayerKarteaSession

class PlayerKarteaSession(id, player, professional, start_date, start_time, end_date, end_time, phase_reached, level_reached, general_score, q_movement, q_collided_target, q_avoided_target, q_collided_obstacle, q_avoided_obstacle, utc_offset='')[source]

Bases: ReflexiveModel

Summary model for Kartea player session data.

Attributes:
idint

Unique identifier for the session.

playerPlayer

The player associated with this session.

professionalProfessional

The professional who conducted the session.

start_datestr

Session start date, ISO 8601 “%Y-%m-%d” (e.g. “2026-09-11”).

start_timestr

Session start time, ISO 8601 “%H:%M:%S” (local time).

end_datestr

Session end date (last save), ISO 8601 “%Y-%m-%d”.

end_timestr

Session end time (last save), ISO 8601 “%H:%M:%S” (local time).

phase_reachedint

Current (last) phase of the session; follows the game, including when the professional regresses. Same as the player’s config and the last event in the session detail.

level_reachedint

Current (last) level of the session (same rule as phase_reached).

general_scoreint

Overall score achieved in the session.

q_movementint

Number of movement events.

q_collided_targetint

Number of target collisions.

q_avoided_targetint

Number of avoided targets.

q_collided_obstacleint

Number of obstacle collisions.

q_avoided_obstacleint

Number of avoided obstacles.

utc_offsetstr

UTC offset of the local dates/times above, ISO 8601 “+HH:MM” (e.g. “-03:00”), taken at the start of the session. Defaults to “” (sessions recorded before this column existed).

PROPERTIESClassVar[list[str]], class attribute

Field names of the class, filled by initialize_reflexive.

DATA_PROPERTIESClassVar[list], class attribute

Default value of each init field (dataclasses.MISSING when the field has none), filled by initialize_reflexive.

REF_PROPERTIEStuple[str, …], class attribute

Fields written as the referenced object’s id by get_data: ("player", "professional").

Methods

set_data(data)

Update session data from a dictionary.

get_data()

Return session data as a list with one dictionary.

Notes

utc_offset has a default and comes last so that CSV files written before this column existed can still be loaded.

Examples

>>> from types import SimpleNamespace
>>> session = PlayerKarteaSession(
...     id=1,
...     player=SimpleNamespace(id=1),
...     professional=SimpleNamespace(id=2),
...     start_date="2025-09-17",
...     start_time="10:00:00",
...     end_date="2025-09-17",
...     end_time="10:30:00",
...     phase_reached=2,
...     level_reached=3,
...     general_score=100,
...     q_movement=50,
...     q_collided_target=10,
...     q_avoided_target=20,
...     q_collided_obstacle=5,
...     q_avoided_obstacle=15,
...     utc_offset="-03:00",
... )
>>> data = session.get_data()[0]
>>> data["player"], data["professional"]
(1, 2)
>>> data["utc_offset"]
'-03:00'
